title: Statement and Collection Timetable — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
Riverbend's statement and collection timetable for the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) fixes the statement cycle, the number of summary statements before the final notice, the notification periods that must pass before any extraordinary collection action, and the balances that can be placed or credit-reported.

## Figures that are the same for every patient class

| Term | Figure |
|---|---|
| Statement cycle: calendar days between consecutive summary statements on a patient-due account | 30 |
| Statement minimum: balance (USD) below which no summary statement is generated for the cycle | 5.00 |
| Notification period: calendar days from the first statement date before any extraordinary collection action (agency placement with credit reporting) may begin | 120 |
| Final-notice lead: calendar days a final notice must precede any extraordinary collection action | 30 |
| Placement day: calendar days from the first statement date at which an unresolved patient-due account is placed with the collection agency | 150 |
| Credit-reporting minimum: placed balance (USD) the agency may report to the consumer credit bureaus | 500.00 |
| Credit-reporting age: calendar days from the first statement date before a placed balance may be credit-reported | 365 |
| Lawsuits, wage garnishments or liens on patient balances | never filed (not permitted) |
| Annual interest on patient balances | 0 percent (Riverbend charges none) |
| Final-notice delivery channel, whatever the patient's paperless preference | U.S. mail |
| Statement consolidation | every patient-due encounter of the guarantor in one mailing |

## Figures that differ by patient class

| Patient class | Summary statements before the final notice | Placement minimum balance (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Outpatient Clinic Visit Account | 3 | 25.00 |
| Outpatient Diagnostic Imaging & Lab Account | 3 | 25.00 |
| Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account | 3 | 50.00 |
| Emergency Department Visit Account | 3 | 50.00 |
| Outpatient Surgery Account | 3 | 100.00 |
| Observation Stay Account | 4 | 100.00 |
| Inpatient Admission Account | 4 | 100.00 |

The placement minimum is the smallest patient balance that is placed with the collection agency; a smaller balance stays in house.

## Reading the timetable

*Example (hypothetical balances).* On an Observation Stay Account the fifth statement is the final notice, because four summary statements precede it; on an Outpatient Clinic Visit Account the fourth is. An Observation Stay balance of 99.99 is never placed; one of 100.00 can be.
